WHAT ARE YOU ACTUALLY SEEING?

One Ada.
Two kinds of reality.

The historical section: one daguerreotype and two reproductions of painted portraits. Each item lists its creator, approximate date and source. Paintings are not labelled as period photographs.

The beach section: three new AI-generated images. The character is a creative visualisation inspired by Ada, not an exact reconstruction of her appearance or events from her life.

* “Remote since 1843” is our joke. The historical images remain historical; the beach, laptops and holiday scenarios are fictional. AI images created on 11 November 2026.
